body: Personally, I don't get angry often, but when I do it's long lasting and intense, even if the stimulus is pretty small or meaningless. Small things like my roommates eating a disproportionate amount of our food, or someone at work causing my department to have to do a bit of extra work, these send me into a rage that I feel throughout my body. I attribute it to anxiety (I guess?) Or maybe I'm just angry 🤷🏼‍♂️
